text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through visiting Azuma-san and conversing 
with her, 
I eventually had the opportunity to learn 
about her personal interests.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Works chronicling the bonds between 
Umamusume and people 
are a personal favorite of mine to gather.
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if she'll like the book I found 
today.)

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This volume is... 
truly splendid.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Daily accounts recorded from a personal 
perspective, 
weaving together the missing pieces of 
history 
between Umamusume and humans—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Would it perhaps be more fitting 
to call this a diary rather than a book?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
With a narrative tone distinct from the 
archives, 
it vividly paints a portrait of Umamusume 
and humans 
living hand in hand.
choice_data_list:
Right? I thought it was a thoroughly 
compelling read!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had been a chance encounter. 
An elderly gentleman I struck up a 
conversation with 
at a race cafe offered it to me if I was 
interested.

text_block_list.name: Kind Old Man
text_block_list.text:
—See, we've got an ancestor's diary 
passed down in our family for generations.

text_block_list.name: Kind Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Rather than letting it gather dust in a 
drawer, 
I reckon my ancestor would be far happier 
knowing it's of use to a shrine maiden.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
So you acquired this not by browsing 
bookstores, 
but through a profound connection with 
another person.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Small wonder, then. ...Secluded in this 
sanctuary, 
rarely forging deep bonds with anyone, 
such a treasure would be difficult for me 
to obtain.
choice_data_list:
Well, you're connecting with me right now, 
aren't you?

Well, you're connecting with me right now, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: —...With you.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'm sure we'll come across some 
great books.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given her duties, I'm sure she's busy, 
but surely it wouldn't be impossible if we 
carved out some time. 
And so—
choice_data_list:
If you'd like, why don't we go look for 
some together?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Together. 
However, someone of my standing—
choice_data_list:
Because there will be new encounters 
waiting for you!
It'll help enrich the archives, too.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
... 
New ties, you say?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
... 
If it may bring forth such blessings 
as the one you have bestowed upon me 
today—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Then let us go. 
To discover even more tomes.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
... 
Is that so?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, we'll expand the collection more 
than ever!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...If taking action allows me to preserve 
even more history of humans and Umamusume 
for posterity...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Then I, Azuma, 
humbly accept your invitation.
